answer: An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 5 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. The terrace counter is kept in delta and ember shows each threshold crossing. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that burns. That bill is paid per identity, so 222 aliases cost 145 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
